mentions.name: Mac speech-to-text app
mentions.description: A Mac speech-to-text app built using Parakeet and Whisper models, started after a poor billing-support experience with an existing dictation tool (Wisper Flow). Development progress was accelerated with AI assistance, and the author is unsure whether to release it publicly.
mentions.problem: The existing speech-to-text tool the author used (Wisper Flow) gave a bad experience with its billing support.
mentions.source_excerpt: so I started building my own version of a speech to text app, it's very doable with Parakeet and Whisper models available now. I've got the app working on mac and it's been so much easier to make progress on it with AI available now.
